mission: Deep-dive maturity audit + deploy-gate task set for Roost production mode
summary: Line-verified audit (.seedrop/view/knowledge/audit.md) of Roost production-mode correctness: 3 P0 bugs (shared Postgres session = concurrency crash at swarm.py:128; no transaction boundary around a step — each store commits independently; recovery discovery Redis-only at swarm.py:492 violates policy agreement #5), 3 P1 doc/code mismatches (replay oversold vs latest-only snapshots; link_child regression between modes; roost_operator_actions dead schema), 4 P2 smells (pg_advisory_xact_lock no-op since it commits immediately; trigger baby-DSL; thin observability; lazy store swap). Authored 9 tasks in .seedrop/view/tasks/ keyed to findings with file:line anchors + done-when checklists; TASK-DEPLOY-GATE.md is the index. Wired audit + tasks into policy.json path_purposes. Note: seed view sync still bloats manifest (1437 files, ignores .gitignore) — pre-existing tooling gap.
